actualChoices.picnic: לרדת על is both eating/devouring and an oral-sex idiom; anticipated picnic preserved.
actualChoices.fireflies: לבוא וללכת keeps free movement, and לבוא על סיפוקן adds the sexual-satisfaction hinge while retaining all facts.
actualChoices.wolf: מלא אומץ/אמלא אותך shifts courage-fullness to physical filling; imminent semen is established by the complete surrounding exchange.
